how: We read the website of every Dallas-Fort Worth wedding florist listed on Lazo (280 listings, 215 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: same-day delivery shops, a silk-flower rental company, a bouquet preservation studio, a cake bakery, and venues and planners mis-listed as florists. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Do you design for the venue, or deliver arrangements? Installation and teardown are the difference in price.
How do you keep flowers alive through a Texas summer ceremony outdoors, and what do you avoid in July and August?
Can I see a full wedding's florals, not a bouquet photo, at a budget like mine?

picks.name: Sage Fine Flowers
picks.blurb: Founded in 2014 by lead designer Tisa, with an organic, European-art-inspired aesthetic for custom installations. Sage says every wedding is custom, anywhere from $100 to $100,000 in budget. Every client gets the same care regardless of what they spend.

picks.name: Haute Floral
picks.blurb: Creative director Kristen Wolchik launched Haute Floral in 2005 as a luxury floral and event design studio in Dallas, with a team of designers working weddings as well as corporate and social events.

picks.name: Bella Flora of Dallas
picks.blurb: A full-service floral and event design studio with more than 25 years of experience, led by Lucy and Cesar, specializing in luxury weddings and corporate and social events. The site lists press features and galleries.

picks.name: Out of the Garden
picks.blurb: Fifth-generation Texan Donna Smith opened Out of the Garden in 1991 after years with two other local florists, for clients who wanted an out-of-the-ordinary approach. Wedding flowers alongside hotel and corporate work across DFW.

picks.name: Boujee Bloom
picks.blurb: Luxury wedding florals and event design, from romantic aisles to sky-high installations, from a team with over a decade in event design. Based in Aubrey, serving Dallas-Fort Worth.

picks.name: Vella Nest Floral Design
picks.blurb: Garden-inspired wedding florals designed with intention, with blooms sourced from Italy and Holland. Vella Nest, in Duncanville, also offers a smaller-scale option for intimate weddings and gatherings in its signature style.

picks.name: Feisty Florals
picks.blurb: Allie traded high school lesson plans for floral recipes full-time in 2022 and now runs a design studio in Lewisville. Full-service weddings and an a la carte option covering bouquets, boutonnieres, smaller centerpieces and ceremony florals.

picks.name: Event Stems
picks.blurb: Martha, owner and lead designer, started six years ago with a Dallas storefront and now focuses on custom wedding florals for couples who care about detail. There is a dedicated inquiry form for micro weddings.

picks.name: Pretty Little Everythings
picks.blurb: Autumn offers full-service wedding floral and decor, a la carte wedding flowers, event rentals and day-of coordination from one Fort Worth business. She started her first business in 2012 doing handmade decor for showers and kids' parties.

picks.name: The Floral Eclectic - Dallas Wedding Event Florist
picks.blurb: Taylor fell in love with floral design about eight years ago and started The Floral Eclectic three years in, with custom fabrication alongside the flowers and a stated taste for anything vintage, spooky and cute. Based in Dallas, serving clients worldwide.

picks.name: Coco Fleur Events
picks.blurb: Lisa Stiles leads Coco Fleur with over 20 years of experience, designing floral for Dallas-Fort Worth and beyond out of Pilot Point, with a promise that every bride should feel like a million bucks.

picks.name: Lavender and Love Florals LLC
picks.blurb: Makenna Callaway learned floral design under a mentor at a flower shop in Searcy, Arkansas, and runs Lavender and Love as an expression of love and faith. The wedding process starts with a consultation; she serves Dallas-Fort Worth from Mansfield.
